author: Sample commentary (synthetic data)
headline: In FY2025, Fire spent 8.1% more than its original budget and Homelessness and Supportive Housing 8.5% less.
paragraphs: Budget versus actual compares the original adopted budget with year-end actuals. Overspending in public safety is usually overtime; underspending in housing and homelessness usually means projects and hiring lagged the appropriation. Both are stories about capacity, not necessarily about control.
The dumbbell shows each department's original budget and actual; the heat grid shows the pattern over years so a one-off can be told from a habit.

templates.template: FY{fy}, {depts_fmt} departments: actual spending was {gap_total} versus the original budget ({gap_pct}); {over_fmt} departments overspent by more than 5%, {under_fmt} underspent by more than 5%.
templates.fallback: Too few records match to summarize; widen the years or clear a filter.

caveats.text: Supplemental appropriations during the year are in the revised budget; the gap to the revised budget is shown in the table.
